question: What claim is made about the transmission of the practice of the soul to the one addressed as Bhairavī?
premises: A practice of the soul is at issue.
That practice has been told to the addressed one.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not given in this verse alone
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
